title: averin Checkpoint v2
description: Frontier checkpoint: commits the set of head content-hashes for one project, hash-chained and externally anchored. Structure only — RCP §9.4/§10 defines canonical bytes, frontier computation, and the offline verification algorithm. The `anchor` block is added AFTER signing and is excluded from checkpoint_hash/sig.

frontier.description: de-duplicated AND byte-sorted head content-hashes (RCP §10); schema cannot assert sortedness

broker_grant_head.description: OPTIONAL grant-transparency head (ADR 0004 D6/MF2): the cumulative_root over the broker's grant log [1..max_seq] folded in broker_seq order, chained to the previous checkpoint's cumulative_root. Inside the signed/anchored checkpoint so the broker cannot equivocate on the grant log. Absent on pre-D6 checkpoints.

max_seq.description: highest broker_seq committed by this checkpoint (0 = no grants)

prior_head_hash.description: previous checkpoint's cumulative_root (empty-log root for the first)

cumulative_root.description: sha256 hash-chain over (broker_seq, grant content_hash) in seq order

anchor.description: added AFTER signing; excluded from checkpoint_hash/sig preimage

token_b64.description: DER TimeStampToken (RFC3161) or test-anchor token, base64

anchored_ts.description: anchor time as reported by the TSA; precision may exceed ms — preserved verbatim
